title: Roll back to the node that caused a verification defect
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. When verification fails, Fangore wants structured attribution naming the repair target so the graph rolls back to that layer instead of restarting from scratch. Accepts WalkingLabs P08 guidance[^wl-p08-rollback].
implementation:
`attribute_with_repair_target` / `select_rollback_target`; `CliInstrumentor` verb `targeted_rollback_select`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
